title: Rules.
bodyText: Subject to chapter 91, the board may adopt rules for the government of all teachers, educational officers, other personnel, and pupils, and for carrying out the transaction of its business.
caseNotes: Where plaintiff part-time teachers argued that their hourly pay rate, established in school code regulation 5203, was linked to the substitute teachers' per diem pay rate established under §302A-624, the circuit court erred in awarding summary judgment for plaintiffs and determining that plaintiffs were entitled to hourly back wages subject to control and adjustment by the board of education under chapter 89C because regulation 5203 was not a rule adopted under the authority of the board of education pursuant to this section; did not have the force and effect of law; and was instead an internal policy within the school code that could be amended at any time. 140 H. 139, 398 P.3d 728 (2017).

bodyHtml:
[§302A-1112]  Rules.  Subject to chapter 91, the board may adopt rules for the government of all teachers, educational officers, other personnel, and pupils, and for carrying out the transaction of its business. [L 1996, c 89, pt of §2]

 

Law Journals and Reviews

 

  The Privacy Rights of Public School Students.  32 UH L. Rev. 305 (2010).

 

Case Notes

 

  Where plaintiff part-time teachers argued that their hourly pay rate, established in school code regulation 5203, was linked to the substitute teachers' per diem pay rate established under §302A-624, the circuit court erred in awarding summary judgment for plaintiffs and determining that plaintiffs were entitled to hourly back wages subject to control and adjustment by the board of education under chapter 89C because regulation 5203 was not a rule adopted under the authority of the board of education pursuant to this section; did not have the force and effect of law; and was instead an internal policy within the school code that could be amended at any time.  140 H. 139, 398 P.3d 728 (2017).
